messages.subject: Re: 3D mesh to voxel volume
messages.body_plain:
Dear Antonio,

There  not a function that does exactly what you want but by combining a few functions you can probably get there.

First of all, what exactly do you want by way of output? A 3D array of voxels? Written out to an image file on disk eventually? What should be the dimensions/ bounding box / voxel dimensions of this array? Does it have a non zero origin. You need to decide this.

Is the goal to map the mesh surface onto a regular voxel grid or produce a volume where each voxel inside the mesh is positive? If it is the former, something like Rvcg::vcgUniformRemesh function might do what you want. If the latter, read on.

In the package nat 3D image arrays have class im3d. What you need to do is probably

1. Define an im3d object with the correct dimensions
2. Use imexpand.grid to obtain a matrix of 3D coordinates, one row for each voxel in the complete volume
3. Use the pointsinside function to test if each point is inside or outside the mesh
4. Set the voxels of the im3d object to 1 for points inside the mesh, 0 otherwise

If you post a sample mesh and define the voxel grid you need I may be able to help fill in the details of the steps above. Note that the pointsinside function is relatively slow. If the mesh occupies only a small portion of your desired voxel grid, then it will be much quicker to test if the point falls inside the 3D boundingbox of your mesh before testing if it falls inside the mesh itself.

Best wishes,

Greg.

PS please note I have cced the nat-users mailing list so others might benefit from this discussion.

Sent from my iPhone

I noticed the NBLAST on the fly service for finding GAL4 drivers doesn't seem to be working. When I enter the FlyCircuit Neuron ID and try to query for GAL4 drivers, I get this error. I have used it in the past (a few months ago) and it was working, but as of last week the server seems to be down. Is there anything someone can do to restart and check the server? Thank you!

Thank you for the report. I think the problem is with a second server that it calls to get the scores (@Rob this looks like the VFB R service).

VFB will soon put the whole NBLAST service on a larger dedicated server of its own, which should give improved stability/speed.

Best,

Greg.
